jury_question: Who should carry the cost of a pay rise above £500 million, and who should have the last word on the deal: taxpayers nationally, councils, or care workers and users?
jury_options: National taxpayers pay in full, with a set cap and review date
Government pays, but only up to a fixed cap; the talks stay within it
Councils share the cost, with a say in the deal
Care workers and care users approve the deal, Parliament approves the money
